verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: man madhukar gat bhramat chatur ku(n)T charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT samaieeaai ||

en.bdb: The mind wanders like a bumble bee in all four directions. But by coming into the refuge of True Guru and by the blessings of Naam Simran, he merges into peace and comfort of equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: seetal suga(n)dh at komal anoop roop madh makara(n)dh ras anat na dhaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Once the calming, scented, delicate and very beautiful elixir-like holy dust of the feet of True Guru is received, the mind does not wander in any direction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਰੁਨ ਝੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh unaman jagamag jot anahadh dhun run jhun liv laieeaai ||

en.bdb: On account of his association with the holy feet of the True Guru, by remaining in a state of divine will and tranquil state of meditation and ever enjoying a glimpse of the light effulgent, he remains engrossed in the melodious unstruck celestial music.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਾ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh bees ik iees soha(n) soiee jaanai aapaa apara(n)par param padh paieeaai ||222||

en.bdb: Believe it! An obedient Sikh of the True Guru becomes aware of the One Lord who is beyond all limits. And thus he reaches the supreme spiritual state. (222)
